content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB version of plot_wave_vessel_island.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_island_beach case, adding a user-input section and two toggles. User inputs: fdir='output/' (L9), fdep=fdir (so depth.txt is expected in the output directory, L12), do_not_show_figure=false to hide the figure while rendering (L16, applied L52-L54), show_time=true to title frames with simulation time (L19, applied L84-L87). It prompts for frame range ns/ne (L26-L27), loads eta_00001 into unused mask and depth.txt into dep1 (L30-L31), sizes the grid (L34), and builds coordinates from x0=y0=0.0, dx=2.0, dy=dx (L37-L42). It opens VideoWriter movie.avi at 10 fps (L46-L48) and a 6x6-inch figure (L57-L59). Per frame num=ns:ne (L61-L96): zero-pads (L65), loads eta_<fnum> (L68), NaNs eta>10.0 (L71), pcolor with interp shading and caxis [-0.5 0.5] (L77-L78), labels (L80-L81), optional title 'Time = <(num-1)*2.5> sec' (L84-L87), pause, frame capture and write (L89-L93). Closes the video (L98).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
fdep — depth directory, equal to fdir (L12)
mask — array from eta_00001, never used (L30)
dy — grid spacing, equal to dx (L40)

equations.ref: removing masked/dry regions (sentinel values) before plotting
time label assuming 2.5 s output interval

io.name: per-frame pcolor of eta with optional time title

unresolved: The 2.5 s output interval hardcoded in the time label (L85) must match PLOT_INTV in the case input; unverifiable here.
fdep=fdir (L12) expects depth.txt inside output/, while mk_depth.m writes it to the working directory — the user must move the file; the uncommented sibling reads it from '' instead.
mask (L30) is loaded but never used.
The eta>10.0 sentinel convention for masked regions (L71) is assumed from the output format, not documented in this file.
